items.title: Earnings Surge Could Be A Game Changer For Chevron Stock (CVX)
items.summary: Chevron reported third quarter earnings of US$9.9b, with nearly triple profit versus a year earlier, supported by record U.S. refinery throughput, stronger refining margins, lower debt and new upstream exposure in Venezuela and offshore Greece. The dividend currently appears covered at about US$65 Brent per barrel. items.title: 5 High-Yield Dividend Stocks That Put Payout Safety Ahead of Yield
items.summary: Chasing the biggest yield is how retirees get burned by a dividend cut. These five income stocks span tobacco, pharma, pipelines, utilities and oil, and each one faces a risk worth knowing before you buy.

items.title: ExxonMobil Sinks 14% and Chevron 12% in a Month as Trump Says Iran Wants “to Make a Deal”
